dwarf/dwarf_ability_scores.json.description: Dwarves are both tough and wise, but also a bit gruff.
dwarf/dwarf_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom, -2 Charisma

dwarf/dwarf_defensive_training.json.description: Dwarves get a +4 dodge bonus to AC against monsters of the giant subtype.
dwarf/dwarf_defensive_training.json.name: Defensive Training

target_bonuses.target: Appraise=to assess nonmagical metals or gemstones

dwarf/dwarf_greed.json.description: Dwarves receive a +2 racial bonus on Appraise skill checks made to determine the price of nonmagical goods that contain precious metals or gemstones.
dwarf/dwarf_greed.json.name: Greed

dwarf/dwarf_hardy.json.description: Dwarves receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.
dwarf/dwarf_hardy.json.name: Hardy

dwarf/dwarf_hatred.json.description: Dwarves receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the orc and goblinoid subtypes due to special training against these hated foes.
dwarf/dwarf_hatred.json.name: Hatred

dwarf/dwarf_languages.json.description: Dwarves begin play speaking Common and Dwarven. Dwarves with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Terran, and Undercommon.
dwarf/dwarf_languages.json.name: Languages

dwarf/dwarf_size.json.description: Dwarves are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
dwarf/dwarf_size.json.name: Medium

dwarf/dwarf_speed.json.description: Dwarves have a base speed of 20 feet, but their speed is never modified by armor or encumbrance.
dwarf/dwarf_speed.json.name: Slow and Steady

dwarf/dwarf_stability.json.description: Dwarves receive a +4 racial bonus to their Combat Maneuver Defense when resisting a bull rush or trip attempt while standing on the ground.
dwarf/dwarf_stability.json.name: Stability

dwarf/dwarf_stonecunning.json.description: Dwarves receive a +2 bonus on Perception checks to potentially notice unusual stonework, such as traps and hidden doors located in stone walls or floors. They receive a check to notice such features whenever they pass within 10 feet of them, whether or not they are actively looking.
dwarf/dwarf_stonecunning.json.name: Stonecunning

dwarf/dwarf_vision.json.description: Dwarves can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
dwarf/dwarf_vision.json.name: Darkvision

dwarf/dwarf_weapon_familiarity.json.description: Dwarves are proficient with battleaxes, heavy picks, and warhammers, and treat any weapon with the word "dwarven" in its name as a martial weapon.
dwarf/dwarf_weapon_familiarity.json.name: Weapon Familiarity

elf/elf_ability_scores.json.description: Elves are nimble, both in body and mind, but their form is frail.
elf/elf_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, -2 Constitution

elf/elf_elven_immunities.json.description: Elves are immune to magic sleep effects and get a +2 racial saving throw bonus against enchantment spells and effects.
elf/elf_elven_immunities.json.name: Elven Immunities

elf/elf_elven_magic.json.description: Elves receive a +2 racial bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance. In addition, elves receive a +2 racial bonus on Spellcraft skill checks made to identify the properties of magic items.
elf/elf_elven_magic.json.name: Elven Magic

elf/elf_keen_senses.json.description: Elves receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception skill checks.
elf/elf_keen_senses.json.name: Keen Senses

elf/elf_languages.json.description: Elves begin play speaking Common and Elven. Elves with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Celestial, Draconic, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan.
elf/elf_languages.json.name: Languages

elf/elf_size.json.description: Elves are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
elf/elf_size.json.name: Medium

elf/elf_speed.json.description: Elves have a base speed of 30 feet.
elf/elf_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

elf/elf_vision.json.description: Elves can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
elf/elf_vision.json.name: Low-Light Vision

elf/elf_weapon_familiarity.json.description: Elves are proficient with longbows (including composite longbows), longswords, rapiers, and shortbows (including composite shortbows), and treat any weapon with the word "elven" in its name as a martial weapon.
elf/elf_weapon_familiarity.json.name: Weapon Familiarity

gnome/gnome_ability_scores.json.description: Gnomes are physically weak but surprisingly hardy, and their attitude makes them naturally agreeable.
gnome/gnome_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Constitution, +2 Charisma, -2 Strength

gnome/gnome_defensive_training.json.description: Gnomes get a +4 dodge bonus to AC against monsters of the giant subtype.
gnome/gnome_defensive_training.json.name: Defensive Training

gnome/gnome_gnome_magic.json.description: Gnomes add +1 to the DC of any saving throws against illusion spells that they cast. Gnomes with a Charisma of 11 or higher also gain the following spell-like abilities: 1/day--dancing lights, ghost sound, prestidigitation, and speak with animals. The caster level for these effects is equal to the gnome's level. The DC for these spells is equal to 10 + the spell's level + the gnome's Charisma modifier.
gnome/gnome_gnome_magic.json.name: Gnome Magic

gnome/gnome_hatred.json.description: Gnomes receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the reptilian and goblinoid subtypes due to special training against these hated foes.
gnome/gnome_hatred.json.name: Hatred

gnome/gnome_illusion_resistance.json.description: Gnomes get a +2 racial saving throw bonus against illusion spells and effects.
gnome/gnome_illusion_resistance.json.name: Illusion Resistance

gnome/gnome_keen_senses.json.description: Gnomes receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception skill checks.
gnome/gnome_keen_senses.json.name: Keen Senses

gnome/gnome_languages.json.description: Gnomes begin play speaking Common, Gnome, and Sylvan. Gnomes with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Goblin, and Orc.
gnome/gnome_languages.json.name: Languages

gnome/gnome_obsessive.json.description: Gnomes receive a +2 racial bonus on a Craft or Profession skill of their choice.
gnome/gnome_obsessive.json.name: Obsessive

gnome/gnome_size.json.description: Gnomes are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to their Combat Maneuver Bonus and Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.
gnome/gnome_size.json.name: Small

gnome/gnome_speed.json.description: Gnomes have a base speed of 20 feet.
gnome/gnome_speed.json.name: Slow Speed

gnome/gnome_vision.json.description: Gnomes can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
gnome/gnome_vision.json.name: Low-Light Vision

gnome/gnome_weapon_familiarity.json.description: Gnomes treat any weapon with the word "gnome" in its name as a martial weapon.
gnome/gnome_weapon_familiarity.json.name: Weapon Familiarity

half_elf/half_elf_ability_scores.json.description: Half-elf characters get a +2 bonus to one ability score of their choice at creation to represent their varied nature.
half_elf/half_elf_ability_scores.json.name: +2 to One Ability Score

half_elf/half_elf_adaptability.json.description: Half-elves receive Skill Focus as a bonus feat at 1st level.
half_elf/half_elf_adaptability.json.name: Adaptability

half_elf/half_elf_elf_blood.json.description: Half-elves count as both elves and humans for any effect related to race.
half_elf/half_elf_elf_blood.json.name: Elf Blood

half_elf/half_elf_elven_immunities.json.description: Half-elves are immune to magic sleep effects and get a +2 racial saving throw bonus against enchantment spells and effects.
half_elf/half_elf_elven_immunities.json.name: Elven Immunities

half_elf/half_elf_keen_senses.json.description: Half-elves receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception skill checks.
half_elf/half_elf_keen_senses.json.name: Keen Senses

half_elf/half_elf_languages.json.description: Half-elves begin play speaking Common and Elven. Half-elves with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic).
half_elf/half_elf_languages.json.name: Languages

half_elf/half_elf_multitalented.json.description: Half-elves choose two favored classes at first level and gain +1 hit point or +1 skill point whenever they take a level in either one of those classes.
half_elf/half_elf_multitalented.json.name: Multitalented

half_elf/half_elf_size.json.description: Half-elves are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
half_elf/half_elf_size.json.name: Medium

half_elf/half_elf_speed.json.description: Half-elves have a base speed of 30 feet.
half_elf/half_elf_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

half_elf/half_elf_vision.json.description: Half-elves can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
half_elf/half_elf_vision.json.name: Low-Light Vision

half_orc/half_orc_ability_scores.json.description: Half-orc characters get a +2 bonus to one ability score of their choice at creation to represent their varied nature.
half_orc/half_orc_ability_scores.json.name: +2 to One Ability Score

half_orc/half_orc_intimidating.json.description: Half-orcs receive a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate skill checks due to their fearsome nature.
half_orc/half_orc_intimidating.json.name: Intimidating

half_orc/half_orc_languages.json.description: Half-orcs begin play speaking Common and Orc. Half-orcs with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Abyssal, Draconic, Giant, Gnoll, and Goblin.
half_orc/half_orc_languages.json.name: Languages

half_orc/half_orc_orc_blood.json.description: Half-orcs count as both humans and orcs for any effect related to race.
half_orc/half_orc_orc_blood.json.name: Orc Blood

half_orc/half_orc_orc_ferocity.json.description: Once per day, when a half-orc is brought below 0 hit points but not killed, he can fight on for one more round as if disabled. At the end of his next turn, unless brought to above 0 hit points, he immediately falls unconscious and begins dying.
half_orc/half_orc_orc_ferocity.json.name: Orc Ferocity

half_orc/half_orc_size.json.description: Half-orcs are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
half_orc/half_orc_size.json.name: Medium

half_orc/half_orc_speed.json.description: Half-orcs have a base speed of 30 feet.
half_orc/half_orc_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

half_orc/half_orc_vision.json.description: Half-orcs can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
half_orc/half_orc_vision.json.name: Darkvision

half_orc/half_orc_weapon_familiarity.jso.description: Half-orcs are proficient with greataxes and falchions and treat any weapon with the word "orc" in its name as a martial weapon.
half_orc/half_orc_weapon_familiarity.jso.name: Weapon Familiarity

halfling/halfling_ability_scores.json.description: Halflings are nimble and strong-willed, but their small stature makes them weaker than other races.
halfling/halfling_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, -2 Strength

halfling/halfling_fearless.json.description: Halflings receive a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws against fear. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by halfling luck.
halfling/halfling_fearless.json.name: Fearless

halfling/halfling_halfling_luck.json.description: Halflings receive a +1 racial bonus on all saving throws.
halfling/halfling_halfling_luck.json.name: Halfling Luck

halfling/halfling_keen_senses.json.description: Halflings receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception skill checks.
halfling/halfling_keen_senses.json.name: Keen Senses

halfling/halfling_languages.json.description: Halflings begin play speaking Common and Halfling. Halflings with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, and Goblin.
halfling/halfling_languages.json.name: Languages

halfling/halfling_size.json.description: Halflings are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to their Combat Maneuver Bonus and Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.
halfling/halfling_size.json.name: Small

halfling/halfling_speed.json.description: Halflings have a base speed of 20 feet.
halfling/halfling_speed.json.name: Slow Speed

halfling/halfling_sure_footed.json.description: Halflings receive a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Climb skill checks.
halfling/halfling_sure_footed.json.name: Sure-Footed

halfling/halfling_weapon_familiarity.jso.description: Halflings are proficient with slings and treat any weapon with the word "halfling" in its name as a martial weapon.
halfling/halfling_weapon_familiarity.jso.name: Weapon Familiarity

human/human_ability_scores.json.name: +2 to One Ability Score

human/human_bonus_feat.json.name: Bonus Feat
